audit.whatIsWrong: win[] and phases[].side gave Gwen levels 2, 3 and two items, contradicting whys[1], whys[2] and whys[6].
audit.why: Bladesurge resets off the wave let her stick before Gwen has Mist, level 3 is described as a coin-flip skirmish, and whys[6] says neither champion out-scales the other into teamfights.
audit.corrected: Skill / Irelia / Skill / Irelia / Gwen / Gwen / Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown anywhere on a page built entirely around timing windows - the packet flags this matchup specifically for it.
audit.why: Bladesurge 10/9/8/7/6, Defiant Dance 20/18/16/14/12, Flawless Duet 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 and Vanguard's Edge 125/105/85 against Hallowed Mist at 22s. Her E returns in 16s while your Mist takes 22s, so you do not get a mist for every Flawless Duet - that asymmetry is the reason you have to bait rather than react, and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: early, mid, whys[2] and wants.you[0] now carry the numbers and the asymmetry.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flawless Duet's grounding and Bladesurge's healing are both absent.
audit.why: Flawless Duet carries grounding alongside hardCC, so it does not merely stun you through her reset chain - it disables Skip 'n Slash for the duration, meaning your escape is gone after the stun expires too. Bladesurge carries the heal flag, so every minion reset tops her up, which is why chip poke never gets her low.
audit.corrected: early and mid state that Flawless Duet grounds your dash; late and whys[5] name Grievous Wounds against Bladesurge's per-reset healing.

edits.before: Both of you are soft at level 1, but Irelia edges the early levels because Bladesurge resets off the minion wave let her dash in, stick, and out-shred you before you have any mist. Don't step up to melee-trade Snip Snip! when her Q is up and the wave is low — she'll surf a minion onto you and you can't peel her off. Last-hit at the tip of your Q cone, tag her with the true-damage center snip when she walks up to farm, and respect Flawless Duet (E) — eating that stun without W up means you're locked through her whole reset chain. Hold your trades until 6.
edits.after: Both of you are soft at level 1, but Irelia edges the early levels because Bladesurge resets off the minion wave — a 10s cooldown that refunds on every kill — let her dash in, stick, and heal off each reset before you have any mist. Do not melee-trade Snip Snip! when her Q is up and the wave is low. Last-hit at the tip of your cone, tag her with the true-damage centre snip when she walks up, and respect Flawless Duet (E, 16s): it stuns AND grounds, so Skip 'n Slash stays disabled even after the stun ends. Hold your trades until 6.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still hers if you haven't hit 6 — her passive stacks Ionian Fervor shred and a well-timed Defiant Dance (W) eats your Q burst, so she wins the extended reset duel. The lane flips at 6: Needlework plus your full Q-W-E kit finally answers her engage. The whole fight is the W timing — drop Hallowed Mist the instant her Flawless Duet blades are out or as she Bladesurges in, so she has to stand inside the cloud to hit you and resets from outside can't target you at all. Then R-slow her, snip her HP with the %-max-HP cone, and heal it back off the damage.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still hers if you have not hit 6 — Ionian Fervor shred plus a well-timed Defiant Dance (W, 20s) eats your Q burst, so she wins the extended reset duel. The lane flips at 6, and the whole fight is the W timing: drop Hallowed Mist the instant her Flawless Duet blades are out or as she Bladesurges in, so she must stand inside the cloud to hit you. Her E is 16s and your Mist is 22s, so you do not get a fog for every stun — bait it rather than react to it, because the grounding takes your dash too. Then R-slow, snip, and heal it back.

edits.before: This scales out roughly even — neither of you hard out-scales the other, so it stays a skirmish lane into teamfights. Your %-max-HP Snip Snip! and on-hit punish any bruiser HP she stacks, and mist nullifies her dive whenever you're the target she has to reach. The danger is a fed Irelia Bladesurge-chaining through your backline: keep Hallowed Mist on yourself, don't get caught flat-footed by a flanking Flawless Duet, and snip whoever she commits onto. Close fights inside your fog and her reset chains never get rolling.

notes: The packet flags this matchup for having NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and that is accurate - the page says 'when her Q is up', 'time Defiant Dance', 'the whole fight is the W timing' and never gives a single number. Added: Bladesurge 10s at rank 1, Defiant Dance 20s, Flawless Duet 16s, Vanguard's Edge 125s, against your 22s Mist and 13s dash. The decisive omission is that Flawless Duet GROUNDS as well as stuns - the page says eating it 'means you're locked through her whole reset chain', but the real cost is that grounding disables Skip 'n Slash, so you cannot dash out even after the stun ends. Also missing: Bladesurge heals her on every reset, so her wave-surfing is her sustain and no anti-heal is ever named. Chart corrected at four stages to match the prose, and the full layer's 19 'he' references to Irelia are fixed.
